text: By prayer, training and tactics, the templars of Myrmidia will strive to crush the unholy and the unclean.
Captains have risen through the ranks, having first stood amongst the rank and file with a bloody sword in their hands.
Away from institutional colleges and watery cults, generals have to make do by hiring hedge wizards that look moderately reliable.\\nBuy a contract in the Plutocracy panel to hire wizards.
Duellists and Dietros will fight anybody for the right price, favour or well, any reason they may think of.\\nBuy a contract in the Plutocracy panel to improve Master Duellist recruitment.
